sources.title: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Third Quarter Fiscal 2027

scenes.title: Nvidia's $115.8B quarter
scenes.sub: Revenue more than doubled in a year.
scenes.sub_html: Revenue more than doubled in a year.

lines.say: Nvidia just brought in one hundred fifteen point eight billion dollars in three months.
lines.show: Nvidia just brought in $115.8 billion in three months.

lines.say: That's more than double a year ago. Here's where it comes from.
lines.show: That's more than double a year ago. Here's where it comes from.

lines.say: Revenue grew one hundred three percent in a year.
About ninety three percent came from data centers. That's the chips and systems that run AI.
lines.show: About 93% came from data centers. That's the chips and systems that run AI.

scenes.label: kept after costs
scenes.note: After the direct cost of making chips, Q3 fiscal 2027

lines.say: After the cost of making them, Nvidia keeps about seventy five cents of every dollar.
lines.show: After the cost of making them, Nvidia keeps about 75¢ of every dollar.

scenes.label: profit in 3 months
scenes.note: About 56¢ of every dollar of sales

lines.say: Its profit was sixty five point three billion dollars. About fifty six cents of every dollar.
lines.show: Its profit was $65.3 billion. About 56¢ of every dollar.

lines.say: And Nvidia expects about one hundred thirty billion next quarter. That's a forecast, not a promise.
lines.show: And Nvidia expects about $130 billion next quarter. That's a forecast, not a promise.

scenes.takeaway: In a gold rush, sell the shovels.

lines.say: Follow H Flick for more business breakdowns like this.
lines.show: Follow HFLIC for more business breakdowns like this.

lines.say: And send this to a friend who's into AI.
lines.show: And send this to a friend who's into AI.
